title: Japan — systematically

translations.translation: 微波(波长为1毫米至30厘米的高频电磁波)

phrases.translation: 微波辐射计；辐射计；微波探测仪

sentences.sentence: I’ll heat it up in the microwave.
sentences.translation: 我来把它用微波炉热一热。

sentences.sentence: I heard the news indirectly.
sentences.translation: 这消息我是间接听来的。

sentences.sentence: So it tries to control them indirectly.
sentences.translation: 因此它试图间接地控制它们。

sentences.sentence: You are also indirectly predicting the future of your project/process when you choose and configure the process for your project.
sentences.translation: 当您为您的项目选择和配置这个过程时同样要间接地预知您的项目/过程的未来。

sentences.sentence: We domesticated the dog to help us with hunting.
sentences.translation: 我们驯养狗来帮助我们打猎。

sentences.sentence: the philosophical problem of whether there is free will
sentences.translation: 关于是否有自由意志的哲学问题

sentences.sentence: a philosophical argument
sentences.translation: 哲学争论

sentences.sentence: He had been deceived by a young man claiming to be the son of a millionaire.
sentences.translation: 他被一个自称是百万富翁之子的年轻人骗了。

phrases.translation: 人类体格学；身体人类学
进化人类学；演化的人类学

sentences.sentence: "In anthropology, you can't equate third gender with homosexuality," he said.
sentences.translation: “在人类学中，你不能将同性恋和第三性别混同，”他说。

sentences.sentence: When I was a student at Cambridge I remember an anthropology professor holding up a picture of a bone with 28 incisions carved in it.
sentences.translation: 当我还在剑桥读书的时候，我记得有一位人类学的教授拿出一张照片，上面是一根有28个切口的骨头。

sentences.sentence: Not to be the skunk at this party, but I think it's important to ask whether neuroscience reveals anything more than we already know from, say, anthropology.
sentences.translation: 我并不想成为派对上的讨厌鬼，但我认为很重要的是，要问清楚神经科学是否揭示出我们已知之外的东西，比如人类学。

translations.translation: 功能主义, 机能心理学

sentences.sentence: While criticizing neo-realism and neo-functionalism, researchers adhering to the epistemic community approach (ECA) emphasize the importance of original ideas in the policy-shaping process.
sentences.translation: 晚近针对「新现实主义」与「新功能主义」之批判所发展出的「知识社群」研究取向，强调原创理念在政策塑过程中所扮演之重要角色。

phrases.translation: 才艺表演会；业余演出比赛

sentences.sentence: He has a lot of talent , and his work is fresh and interesting.
sentences.translation: 他很有天赋，作品新颖有趣。

sentences.sentence: a persuasive speaker with a natural talent for leadership
sentences.translation: 有领导天赋、颇有辩才的演说者

sentences.sentence: His latest book reveals hidden talents .
sentences.translation: 他最新的一本书展现了他深藏不露的才能。

sentences.sentence: Sadly, she inherited none of her father’s musical talent .
sentences.translation: 可惜的是，她一点都没有继承她父亲的音乐天赋。

sentences.sentence: Your brother is a man of many talents .
sentences.translation: 你的弟弟是个多才多艺的人。

sentences.sentence: There’s a wealth of talent in English football.
sentences.translation: 英格兰足球界人才济济。

sentences.sentence: It's the coalition forces who are to blame for the continuation of the war.
sentences.translation: 是联军应对战争的持续负责。

sentences.sentence: Please detach and fill out the application form.
sentences.translation: 请撕下申请表并填好。

phrases.translation: 液体动力润滑；液动润滑
水动压力，流体压力；铃动压力
水动力扩散；水动力的分散

sentences.sentence: A second type of thermal escape is far more dramatic. This form of thermal escape is called hydrodynamic escape or, more evocatively, the planetary wind.
sentences.translation: 热逸过程的第二种情形更为奇特，可称为流体力学逃逸（hydrodynamic escape），用通俗一些的话说，叫做“行星风”（以便和“太阳风”呼应）。

sentences.sentence: Evolution of stars of all masses takes place on a hydrodynamic time scale .
sentences.translation: 各种质量的恒星的演化，均以流体力学的时间尺度进行。

sentences.sentence: It was theorized with a high degree of probability that the change in period was due to the nonlinearity of the hydrodynamic pressure acting on the upstream face of the dam.
sentences.translation: 据推论最大可能性是在那一时间段非线性水压作用于坝体上游面所造成的差别。

sentences.sentence: the bay’s 13,000 km of shoreline
sentences.translation: 这个海湾 1.3 万公里的海岸线

sentences.sentence: Victims have ranged from the great auk and the lynx to the humble blue stag beetle and Davall's sedge.
sentences.translation: 受害者从大型海雀、猞猁到不值一提的蓝色鹿角虫和Davall's莎草。

sentences.sentence: So the sedge which lines the banks knows hardly any disturbance until the fishermen come with their nets.
sentences.translation: 连两岸的莎草没有带着渔网前来的渔夫的打搅也几乎从不摇摆。

sentences.sentence: The rain and mist can't mask the funky rot. Pink and chum salmon carcasses lie tangled in linguine strands of tidal sedge.
sentences.translation: 薄薄的雨雾并不能遮盖腐臭的味道，粉红色大马哈鱼的尸体杂乱地缠绕在一缕缕潮汐冲来的莎草中。

sentences.sentence: the disproportionate amount of money being spent on defence
sentences.translation: 比例失衡的国防开支

phrases.translation: 化学液体船；化学品运输船
油槽车，运油车；飞机油箱

sentences.sentence: A Greek oil tanker has run aground.
sentences.translation: 一艘希腊油轮已经搁浅了。

sentences.sentence: She spoke of the professional woman's lament that a woman's judgment is questioned more than a man's.
sentences.translation: 她谈到职业女性的悲哀，即女性的判断会比男性的遭到更多的置疑。

translations.translation: 有系统地, 有条理地

sentences.sentence: Rumours of possible human cases in other parts of the country have been systematically followed up.
sentences.translation: 已系统地对关于该国其它地区可能的人间病例的传闻进行跟踪。

sentences.sentence: Never before has anyone systematically looked for the last queen of Egypt.
sentences.translation: 以前没有人曾系统地寻找过这位埃及最后的女王。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 241 单元

Japan
音标：英 /dʒə'pæn/  美 /dʒə'pæn/
n. 日本
短语：made in japan — 日本制造
短语：bank of japan — 日本中央银行
短语：sea of japan — 日本海
短语：democratic party of japan — 日本民主党
短语：japan airlines — 日本航空
短语：yahoo japan — 雅虎日本

microwave
音标：英 /'maɪkrə(ʊ)weɪv/  美 /'maɪkrə'wev/
n. 微波(波长为1毫米至30厘米的高频电磁波)
短语：microwave oven — 微波炉
短语：microwave radiation — 微波辐射，微波射线
短语：microwave technique — 微波技术
短语：microwave communication — 微波通信
短语：microwave radiometer — 微波辐射计；辐射计；微波探测仪
短语：microwave circuit — 微波电路
短语：microwave remote sensing — 微波遥感；微波遥测
短语：microwave device — 微波器件
短语：microwave filter — 微波过滤器
例句：I’ll heat it up in the microwave.
我来把它用微波炉热一热。

adversely
音标：英 /æd'və:sli/  美 /æd'vɝsli/
adv. 不利地,逆向地

indirectly
音标：英 /,ɪndɪ'rek(t)lɪ/  美 /,ɪndə'rɛktli/
adv. 间接地
例句：I heard the news indirectly.
这消息我是间接听来的。
例句：So it tries to control them indirectly.
因此它试图间接地控制它们。
例句：You are also indirectly predicting the future of your project/process when you choose and configure the process for your project.
当您为您的项目选择和配置这个过程时同样要间接地预知您的项目/过程的未来。

domesticate
音标：英 /də'mestɪkeɪt/  美 /də'mɛstɪket/
v. 驯养, 教化
例句：We domesticated the dog to help us with hunting.
我们驯养狗来帮助我们打猎。

philosophical
音标：英 /fɪlə'sɒfɪk(ə)l/  美 /,fɪlə'sɑfɪkl/
adj. 哲学的, 达观的
短语：philosophical analysis — 哲学分析
例句：the philosophical problem of whether there is free will
关于是否有自由意志的哲学问题
例句：a philosophical argument
哲学争论

deceive
音标：英 /dɪ'siːv/  美 /dɪ'siv/
v. 欺骗, 行骗
短语：deceive oneself — 自欺；误解，想错
例句：He had been deceived by a young man claiming to be the son of a millionaire.
他被一个自称是百万富翁之子的年轻人骗了。

aesthetically
音标：英 /iːs'θetɪkəlɪ/  美 /ɛs'θɛtɪkli/
adv. 有审美能力地

anthropology
音标：英 /,ænθrə'pɒlədʒɪ/  美 /'ænθrə'pɑlədʒi/
n. 人类学
短语：cultural anthropology — 文化人类学
短语：physical anthropology — 人类体格学；身体人类学
短语：social anthropology — 社会人类学
短语：evolutionary anthropology — 进化人类学；演化的人类学
短语：visual anthropology — 影视人类学
短语：biological anthropology — 生物人类学
例句："In anthropology, you can't equate third gender with homosexuality," he said.
“在人类学中，你不能将同性恋和第三性别混同，”他说。
例句：When I was a student at Cambridge I remember an anthropology professor holding up a picture of a bone with 28 incisions carved in it.
当我还在剑桥读书的时候，我记得有一位人类学的教授拿出一张照片，上面是一根有28个切口的骨头。
例句：Not to be the skunk at this party, but I think it's important to ask whether neuroscience reveals anything more than we already know from, say, anthropology.
我并不想成为派对上的讨厌鬼，但我认为很重要的是，要问清楚神经科学是否揭示出我们已知之外的东西，比如人类学。

functionalism
音标：英 /'fʌŋ(k)ʃ(ə)n(ə)lɪz(ə)m/  美 /'fʌŋkʃənəlɪzəm/
n. 功能主义, 机能心理学
例句：While criticizing neo-realism and neo-functionalism, researchers adhering to the epistemic community approach (ECA) emphasize the importance of original ideas in the policy-shaping process.
晚近针对「新现实主义」与「新功能主义」之批判所发展出的「知识社群」研究取向，强调原创理念在政策塑过程中所扮演之重要角色。

talent
音标：英 /'tælənt/  美 /'tælənt/
n. 天才,才能
短语：talent for — 天才；有…的天赋
短语：talent development — 人才开发；才能发展
短语：talent show — 才艺表演会；业余演出比赛
短语：talent education — 才能教育
短语：artistic talent — 艺术才能
短语：talent pool — 人才库
短语：literary talent — 文才；文学天赋
短语：natural talent — 天赋，自然禀赋
短语：talent scout — n. 人才发掘者；伯乐
短语：inter-disciplinary talent — 复合型人才
短语：talent agency — 人才机构
例句：He has a lot of talent , and his work is fresh and interesting.
他很有天赋，作品新颖有趣。
例句：a persuasive speaker with a natural talent for leadership
有领导天赋、颇有辩才的演说者
例句：His latest book reveals hidden talents .
他最新的一本书展现了他深藏不露的才能。
例句：Sadly, she inherited none of her father’s musical talent .
可惜的是，她一点都没有继承她父亲的音乐天赋。
例句：Your brother is a man of many talents .
你的弟弟是个多才多艺的人。
例句：There’s a wealth of talent in English football.
英格兰足球界人才济济。

continuation
音标：英 /kəntɪnjʊ'eɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /kən'tɪnjʊ'eʃən/
n. 继续(部分)；续篇
例句：It's the coalition forces who are to blame for the continuation of the war.
是联军应对战争的持续负责。

detach
音标：英 /dɪ'tætʃ/  美 /dɪ'tætʃ/
v. 拆卸,使分开
短语：detach from — 从…分离；拆卸
例句：Please detach and fill out the application form.
请撕下申请表并填好。

hydrodynamic
音标：英 /,haɪdrəʊdaɪ'næmɪk/  美 /,haɪdrodaɪ'næmɪk/
adj. 水力的
短语：hydrodynamic lubrication — 液体动力润滑；液动润滑
短语：hydrodynamic pressure — 水动压力，流体压力；铃动压力
短语：hydrodynamic dispersion — 水动力扩散；水动力的分散
短语：hydrodynamic transmission — 液力变速器
例句：A second type of thermal escape is far more dramatic. This form of thermal escape is called hydrodynamic escape or, more evocatively, the planetary wind.
热逸过程的第二种情形更为奇特，可称为流体力学逃逸（hydrodynamic escape），用通俗一些的话说，叫做“行星风”（以便和“太阳风”呼应）。
例句：Evolution of stars of all masses takes place on a hydrodynamic time scale .
各种质量的恒星的演化，均以流体力学的时间尺度进行。
例句：It was theorized with a high degree of probability that the change in period was due to the nonlinearity of the hydrodynamic pressure acting on the upstream face of the dam.
据推论最大可能性是在那一时间段非线性水压作用于坝体上游面所造成的差别。

shoreline
音标：英 /'ʃɔːlaɪn/  美 /'ʃɔrlaɪn/
n. 海岸线
例句：the bay’s 13,000 km of shoreline
这个海湾 1.3 万公里的海岸线

sedge
音标：英 /sedʒ/  美 /sɛdʒ/
n. [植]莎草
例句：Victims have ranged from the great auk and the lynx to the humble blue stag beetle and Davall's sedge.
受害者从大型海雀、猞猁到不值一提的蓝色鹿角虫和Davall's莎草。
例句：So the sedge which lines the banks knows hardly any disturbance until the fishermen come with their nets.
连两岸的莎草没有带着渔网前来的渔夫的打搅也几乎从不摇摆。
例句：The rain and mist can't mask the funky rot. Pink and chum salmon carcasses lie tangled in linguine strands of tidal sedge.
薄薄的雨雾并不能遮盖腐臭的味道，粉红色大马哈鱼的尸体杂乱地缠绕在一缕缕潮汐冲来的莎草中。

disproportionate
音标：英 /,dɪsprə'pɔːʃ(ə)nət/  美 /disprə'pɔ:ʃənət/
adj. 不成比例的
例句：the disproportionate amount of money being spent on defence
比例失衡的国防开支

tanker
音标：英 /'tæŋkə/  美 /'tæŋkɚ/
n. 油轮
短语：oil tanker — 油轮；油罐车
短语：chemical tanker — 化学液体船；化学品运输船
短语：tanker truck — 油罐卡车
短语：fuel tanker — 油槽车，运油车；飞机油箱
例句：A Greek oil tanker has run aground.
一艘希腊油轮已经搁浅了。

lament
音标：英 /lə'ment/  美 /lə'mɛnt/
n. 悲伤v哀悼
短语：lament over — 哀悼；为……而悲痛
例句：She spoke of the professional woman's lament that a woman's judgment is questioned more than a man's.
她谈到职业女性的悲哀，即女性的判断会比男性的遭到更多的置疑。

systematically
音标：英 /,sɪstə'mætɪklɪ/  美 /,sɪstə'mætɪkl/
adv. 有系统地, 有条理地
例句：Rumours of possible human cases in other parts of the country have been systematically followed up.
已系统地对关于该国其它地区可能的人间病例的传闻进行跟踪。
例句：Never before has anyone systematically looked for the last queen of Egypt.
以前没有人曾系统地寻找过这位埃及最后的女王。
